title: The Add From Server Lite WordPress plugin before 6.0.0 does not restrict SVG uploads to users allowed to post…
description: The Add From Server Lite WordPress plugin versions prior to 6.0.0 allow users with the Author role and above to upload SVG files containing JavaScript. This occurs because the plugin does not restrict SVG uploads to users permitted to post unfiltered HTML, enabling stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks.
